# truenas_scrub_task (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS scrub schedule by pool id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pool` (Number) ID of the pool to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description or notes for this scrub schedule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this scrub schedule is enabled.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the scrub schedule.
- `pool_name` (String) Name of the pool being scrubbed.
- `schedule` (Attributes) Cron schedule for when scrubs should run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `threshold` (Number) Days before a scrub is due when a scrub should automatically start.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Read-Only:

- `dom` (String) Day of month.
- `dow` (String) Day of week (cron format, 7=Sunday).
- `hour` (String) Cron hour.
- `minute` (String) Cron minute.
- `month` (String) Month.
